Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap — that covers it. Couple of clarifying questions from our security team: 

- SOC 2: can you confirm the report date and auditor? We will need the Type II report for our procurement team and would prefer a copy under NDA.
- Logs: please confirm what you capture by default vs. optional (admin console actions, API requests, system events, user content access events).
- Retention & immutability: do you support WORM-style immutability or append-only exports? What's the default retention window and can it be configured per account?
- Export and delivery: do you provide S3 export, syslog/HTTP push, or only downloadable CSV/JSON? Is there an API to stream logs?
- Encryption & access: are logs encrypted at rest and in transit? How is access to logs audited?

I've attached Acme's vendor security questionnaire — if you could have your security team fill the technical sections, that'll help speed procurement.

We'd like to schedule the security Q&A; Wed 12/03 09:00 PT works for our team.

Hi Jane —

Thanks, attaching a few items and answering the checklist below to help your team triage: 

SOC 2
- Report: Current SOC 2 Type II report (audit performed by Delaine & Co.), period 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30.
- Delivery: Full report available under NDA; summary attached (Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf).

Audit logs (summary)
- Default capture: admin console actions (user adds/removes/permission changes), API request/response metadata (timestamps, endpoints, status codes, request IDs), model invocation metadata (model id, token counts, requester id), authentication events (token issuance, key rotations), and system-level events (node restarts, deployments).
- Optional/extended: full request/response payload capture (configurable per account with data handling controls), streaming export to S3, and push to an HTTP endpoint.
- Retention & immutability: default retention 90 days. We support configurable retention up to 7 years for Dedicated/Private customers. Immutability: we provide append-only export bundles for archival (signed manifests) and recommend storing in your S3 with object lock enabled for WORM needs.
- Export formats & APIs: logs available as JSON/CSV downloads, S3 export (scheduled), and a Logs API for programmatic retrieval (supports pagination, filters by request id, timeframe, and model). We also support webhook push for real-time delivery.
- Encryption & access controls: logs encrypted at rest with customer-managed keys (KMS) for Private/Dedicated, TLS in transit. Access to logs is role-based and audited; every log access event is itself recorded in an access audit trail.

Attachments included: Redwood_Audit_Logging_Schema.csv, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf, Redwood_AuditLogging_Sheet.pdf

Next steps we propose:
- I'll start the vendor questionnaire intake and have Aditya (our security engineer) fill the technical sections.
- We can provide the full SOC 2 report once the NDA is in place — I've attached a standard NDA template and can sign if you prefer.
- Security Q&A confirmed for Wed 12/03 09:00 PT — Aditya will join.

If you want any sample logs (redacted) in advance, we can generate a short export showing admin activity + API request traces.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
